statements.impact_statement: The issue is confined to the gif2rgb command-line utility. Direct-Xfer installs libgif7 as a Leptonica dependency but does not install or invoke gif2rgb.
The historical issue applies to the Solaris NSS implementation, not Debian's Mozilla NSS library.
CVE-2026-8376 is specific to 32-bit Perl builds. The Direct-Xfer CI image is built and scanned on linux/amd64, so the 32-bit integer-overflow condition is absent.
Direct-Xfer 1.71.48 forces transitive qs to 6.16.0, which contains the arrayLimit/comma parser fix.
Direct-Xfer 1.71.48 forces transitive qs to 6.16.0, which contains the attacker-controlled isBuffer denial-of-service fix.
The Direct-Xfer container builds rclone v1.75.1 with Go 1.26.6 and verifies embedded golang.org/x/crypto v0.56.0 in go version -m output.

Direct-Xfer keeps rclone v1.75.1 source but updates its embedded google.golang.org/grpc module to v1.85.0-dev.0.20260825072537-93e31b48545e, the exact upstream security-fix version for CVE-2026-84445, and verifies it in go version -m output before publishing the container binary.
Nodemailer 9.1.1 fixes the resolveContent access-policy bypass affecting versions through 9.1.0.
Nodemailer 9.1.1 includes the IDN/Punycode recipient-domain validation fix introduced in the 9.1.x security line.
Nodemailer 9.1.1 includes the linear-time address parsing fix for the crafted address-list denial-of-service issue.
Nodemailer 9.1.1 includes the RFC 5322 comment parsing fix for recipient-domain validation.
